subject: A thank-you before wrap-up
text:
I want to thank one teammate. You helped a lot last week. I know the setup was messy. We disagreed on the layout. That was okay. You listened anyway.

You changed the sign after lunch. It made the evening smoother. I saw relief on several faces. The team felt steadier. You did not take it personally. That matters.

It saved time. It also kept people calm. Your quiet effort did not go unnoticed. The small choices helped. The boxes were moved. The chairs were numbered.

Someone found extra pens. People smiled. We finished on schedule. I am grateful. I hope next time is easier. Please come to the wrap-up coffee. Bring your own cup. Again. Thank you very much.
